# DB's Workouts

> AI-powered workout and nutrition app built by Dean Burt, a REPs certified personal trainer in East London with 12+ years of experience and a 5.0 star rating across 69 Google reviews.

DB's Workouts generates a personalised 7-day training and nutrition plan from a user's body, goals and equipment, and adjusts it weekly based on check-ins. It offers two plans: Personal (£4.99/month) for individuals, and PT Pro (£14.99/month) for personal trainers who want to manage multiple clients from a branded dashboard with check-ins, challenges and progress tracking. A free one-time plan generator is available with no account or card required.

## Key facts

- Founder/trainer: Dean Burt, REPs certified, East London, 12+ years of personal training experience
- Personal plan: £4.99/month — personalised workout programme, full meal plan, exercise demonstrations, weekly check-ins, progress photos
- PT Pro plan: £14.99/month — everything in Personal, plus client dashboard, branded delivery, client check-ins, challenges & streaks, progress tracking for multiple clients
- Free plan generator: one-time personalised plan, no signup required
- Both paid plans are no-contract monthly subscriptions, cancel anytime
- Service area: East London and surrounding boroughs (Stratford, Walthamstow, Ilford, Hackney, Leytonstone, Barking, and more)
